recent.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was a +13 despite the loss. OKC's margin for error vs good teams is just smaller with all the injuries. Losing Alex Caruso to hip soreness certainly a factor tonight, as he's one of OKC's vital two way impact players with JDub, Chet and Wallace out.
